```artifact
Decision Table for Requirement BR-8-1:
| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Patient Consultation Request exists | Generate ONE prescription |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-8-2:
| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Prescription exists | Map to ONE AND ONLY ONE Patient Consultation Request |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-9-1:
| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Chemist exists | Receive ONE OR MORE prescriptions (only required fields) |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-9-2:
| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Prescription exists | Map to ONE AND ONLY ONE Chemist (using Pincode) |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-10-1:
| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Lab exists | Receive ONE OR MORE prescriptions (only required fields) |

Decision Table for Requirement BR-10-2:
| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Prescription exists | Map to ONE AND ONLY ONE Lab (using Pincode) |
```

    "inputs": {"patient_consultation_request_id": "REQ-001"},
